collection.compiler_build: Common source/build paths and verified stage0/LLVM/optimized developer recipe for baseline and candidates. Keep exact compiler driver identities and all shared runtime file checks. Verify focused correctness tests.
collection.contexts: Compare executed argv and ordered environments using only verified compiler-specific namespace substitutions and the stale jobserver exclusion. Retain the actual SDK12 unit counts and output classes.
collection.cpus: Controller CPU8 and measured process CPUs0-7 with eight compiler threads; other heavy builders excluded on this single local host.
collection.edit: Use the known equal-length comment fixture. Before every sample, warm on BEFORE with native Cargo and capture the exact ordinary library compiler invocation. Measure once on AFTER and restore original source/mode. Restore/converge each arm at block end.
collection.state: Fresh per-arm Cargo target/shared/package/runtime state at common physical paths, with immutable source and locked archives only. This primary check-only collector warms, captures, restores and proves freshness of the original check command. The separate conditional test-build fixture must prove both original commands fresh before its first block and converge both at restoration.
collection.validity: Require exit success, expected source/target/output kinds, complete raw final Ir matching self-cost sum and stderr, input/output context integrity, restoration and parked state. Record host observations without filtering count results. Preserve technical failures and correct the cause before fresh collection. Any technical failure ends the complete attempt before effects; replacements require a separate prospective decision. No automatic retry.

privacy_short_circuit.endpoint: ordinary uv library rustc invocation captured from cargo -Zohm-defaults=yes check --locked --offline -j8
privacy_short_circuit.purpose: Skip the pure extern map lookup only when metadata has already established Some(false).

design.A: Matched SDK12 plus shipping #218 runtime (CI-only parent difference authenticated)
design.B: Only the private-dependency Some(false) short circuit
design.method: Paired geometric baseline/candidate ratios with the existing paired_count_statistics reader. Report reduction as 1 minus reciprocal ratio. Exact two-sided sign p reported per block.
design.metric: whole isolated ordinary rustc final Callgrind Ir, inclusive of its own worker threads and procedural macros
design.statistical_scope: Nominal per-block intervals and sign tests. Pair scheduling and exchangeability assumptions apply. Each endpoint has its own claim.
design.stopping: Stop on the first valid block failing either gate. No extra pairs, retries of valid failures, or pooling with SDK6. Report per-block results and order effects.

public_derivative: Only private source-reference paths, host names and unbound authorization slots are omitted; all counts, schedules, seeds, gates and collection boundaries are unchanged.
publication: A new current-stack performance claim requires both fresh blocks and complete correctness checks. A valid failure is reported. Native whole-command time is separate and receives a claim only from its own prospectively fixed validation.
scope: One prospective privacy-map short-circuit exception on the shipping SDK12 plus three lazy-worker caches parent. Primary dirty-check compiler endpoint only.
